items.name: chromium
items.reason: Playwright 1.64.1 builds chromium for glibc Ubuntu/Debian, macOS and Windows only; its host-platform table (coreBundle.js calculatePlatform) has no musl/Alpine entry and falls back to the glibc ubuntu24.04 build, which does not run on musl
items.fallback: managed builds exist only where 03 § 19 lists them (01 TR-001); rules that need this browser are skipped(no-browser) and listed (packs/testing.md TST-008, packs/search-engines.md and packs/answer-engines.md missing-input outcomes); no general chromium-absent rule exists, see wp/WP-102/spec-changes.md § 2

items.name: mysql
items.reason: Oracle's MySQL supported-platforms page (mysql.com/support/supportedplatforms/database.html) lists Microsoft Windows on x86_64 only, and the 9.7 reference manual says MySQL is available for Windows 64-bit; the CDN has no winarm64 archive (HEAD 404)
items.fallback: external database provider, 04 § 4.2 step 1a

items.name: mysql
items.reason: Oracle publishes MySQL generic Linux binaries built against glibc 2.28 only; its supported-platforms matrix lists no Alpine or other musl distribution, and the CDN has no musl archive

items.name: npm-deprecations
items.reason: no downloadable bulk artifact exists: npm publishes `deprecated` only inside per-package packuments (registry.npmjs.org/<name>); the only bulk sources are the CouchDB replica and ecosyste.ms's packages dump (63,693,845,834 bytes, CC-BY-SA-4.0, last built 2026-02-05). 03 § 19 itself scopes this data to 'packages in the project's lockfiles only', i.e. it is queried at fetch time, not shipped
items.fallback: SEC-052 part deprecated-unknown (W): deprecation unknown when the package is absent from the snapshot, 03 § 19; see wp/WP-102/spec-changes.md § 3

items.name: postgresql
items.reason: release 15.19.1 has no postgresql-15.19.1-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip; the vendor's 15.19.1 release notes say 'Add native Windows ARM64 packages for PostgreSQL 16–18' (PostgreSQL 16, 17 and 18 do have windows-arm64 items in the manifest)
items.fallback: external database provider, 04 § 4.2 step 1a

items.name: postgrest
items.reason: PostgREST v16.5 publishes windows-x86-64, macos (aarch64, x86-64), linux-static (aarch64, x86-64) and freebsd archives only; no Windows ARM64 asset (release asset list read from the GitHub API)
items.fallback: external platform mode, 04 § 4.4

items.name: registry-publish-times
items.reason: no downloadable bulk artifact exists: publish times are per-version fields in registry packuments (npm `time`, PyPI/crates.io/Packagist/RubyGems APIs); only huge or stale dumps exist (ecosyste.ms packages dump 63.7 GB CC-BY-SA-4.0 from 2026-02-05; crates.io db-dump covers one ecosystem)
items.fallback: SEC-053 part age-unknown (W): publish time absent from the snapshot, 03 § 19; see wp/WP-102/spec-changes.md § 3

items.name: supabase-auth
items.reason: supabase/auth v2.197.0 and its five most recent releases publish only auth-*-amd64.tar.xz, -arm64.tar.xz/.tar.gz, -x86.tar.gz (all linux x86-64/aarch64 ELF) and -darwin-arm64.tar.gz (Mach-O arm64); there is no Windows or macOS x86-64 binary (asset lists read from the GitHub API, executables inspected)
items.fallback: /auth/v1/* isn't emulated: the service needs platform.supabase.mode external or the rule is notConfigured(supabase-auth), 04 § 4.4

items.name: wordpress-vulnerabilities
items.reason: BLOCKED: the Wordfence Intelligence feed is v3 only (v2 returns 410 Gone, checked 2026-10-22) and v3 returns 401 'API key must be supplied using a Bearer token'; keys are issued to an account holder and their terms forbid sharing or sublicensing the key (per Wordfence's published terms and v3 docs; the wordfence.com pages themselves answered 202 to scripted fetches, so the terms text was read through web search snippets only, UNPROVEN in full). WPScan is commercial (BUILD_MAP WP-102 row). Needs an Operator-owned Wordfence account key and a terms check that redistributing a derived snapshot to licensed customers is allowed
items.fallback: SEC-073 part version-unknown cannot run offline; the check is unavailable until a snapshot exists, 03 § 19 (data snapshots are vendor-built and signed); see wp/WP-102/spec-changes.md § 3
